description: Work management platform for teams to track projects, tasks, goals, and workflows.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public/multi-user apps; Personal Access Tokens (PATs) and Service Accounts for scripts and internal tools.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Asana account and create apps or Personal Access Tokens free in the developer console.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, custom fields, users, webhooks, and batch requests.
mcp_notes: Asana provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for AI client integrations.
rationale: Asana provides a fully documented REST API, self-serve free developer access via PATs or OAuth, and an official MCP server, making it immediately ready for AI agent integration.

evidence.note: Details authentication options including OAuth, Personal Access Tokens, and Service Accounts.
Explains getting started via the developer console and free testing options.
Provides the OpenAPI-generated REST API reference covering broad object scopes.
Lists documentation for Asana's official MCP Server implementation and client integration guides.
